decisions.headline: indiePlay China Indie Game Awards 2026收到700余件投稿，最高奖空缺
decisions.summary: 4Gamer的WePlay Expo 2026授奖礼报道显示，本届indiePlay China Indie Game Awards收到700余件投稿，但最高奖项没有符合标准的获奖作品。
decisions.verification: 基于4Gamer对2026年11月22日上海授奖礼的现场报道；仅采用投稿规模与最高奖空缺两项明确结果。
decisions.reason: 窗口内首次发布的正式奖项结果具有明确信息增量。
decisions.timeNote: 4Gamer于北京时间11月23日11:26发布，位于本期固定窗口内。

entries.headline: indiePlay China Indie Game Awards 2026 leaves its Grand Prize vacant
entries.summary: 4Gamer’s WePlay Expo 2026 ceremony report says the awards received more than 700 submissions, but no entry met the standard for the top prize.
entries.verification: Based on 4Gamer’s report from the November 22 ceremony in Shanghai; only the submission count and vacant top prize are used.
entries.timeNote: Published by 4Gamer at 11:26 AM Beijing time on November 23, within the fixed window.
